title: Record the six-owner centre repair count
body:
## Summary
- Three outputs each need two further owners, and one pair of owners meets in at most one output, so a joint kernel vector needs at least seven owners.
- The complement of the eight pivot columns has 104 ports, so a repair block of size b at most six needs exactly 104b coordinates.
- Partial, no new kappa. This records that count. It does not enumerate the route products.

## Test plan
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/six-owner-repair-count/verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B research/six-owner-repair-count/test_verify.py`
- [x] `python3.12 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/six-owner-repair-count`
- [ ] Maintainer replay on CPython 3.12 from a checkout of this head
